name: horizontal-progressive-carousel
blurb: Auto-advancing carousel with per-slide progress bars for visual time tracking.
description: Carousel with progress indicators under each navigation button showing time remaining before auto-advance. Supports fast-forward animation when manually clicking buttons. Configurable duration and supports vertical layout.
use_when: Slideshows or galleries where users want to see progress and auto-advance timing.
avoid_when: When explicit pause control is needed; auto-advance is always active.
a11y: Navigation buttons are clickable; progress bars are visual only.
